title: Advanced English II
description: Second course in the state's 4-credit English sequence. Builds on Advanced English I with more complex literary analysis, rhetoric, and research writing.

title: Advanced Algebra II
description: Satisfies the Distinguished Level of Achievement's Algebra II requirement. Covers functions, systems of equations, polynomials, rational and radical expressions, and conics.

title: Advanced Chemistry
description: Lab science credit covering atomic structure, bonding, stoichiometry, reactions, gases, solutions, and acid-base chemistry.

title: TCC US History I (HIST 1301)
stateCourseStandard: TCC HIST 1301 — United States History I
description: Dual-credit US History course satisfying part of the Social Studies sequence, earning AA/AS core credit at TCC.

title: TCC Introduction to Sociology (SOCI 1301)
description: Dual-credit sociology course satisfying part of the Social Studies/elective sequence, earning AA/AS core credit at TCC.

title: TCC Spanish I (SPAN 1411)
description: First year of the same-language LOTE sequence, taken as a TCC dual-credit course starting sophomore year. Earns AA/AS elective credit at TCC.

title: AVID 2 + TSI Prep
description: Continues AVID instructional strategies and mentorship; adds TSI Assessment preparation ahead of TCC dual-credit enrollment.
